say:4:1210501001:1.text: Bols, these people are honored guests of the Carmine Whispers. Treat them with the highest courtesy, and please don't be rude.
say:4:1210501001:1.source_cn: 波尔斯，这几位都是血薇帮的贵客。按照最高礼遇，好好招待...

say:5:1210501002:1.text: Also, word travels fast in Rustport. The Carmine Whispers are willing to turn a blind eye to some things while others... not so much. You're a smart man. I don't need to say anything else, do I?
say:5:1210501002:1.source_cn: 锈锚港的墙向来是透风的，有些事，血薇帮可以睁一只眼闭一...

say:6:1210501003:1.text: Yeah... So, they're all honored guests?

say:7:1210501004:1.source_cn: 而且连辛巴达那混小子都算数？！

say:8:1210501005:1.text: He's the one that found our esteemed guests.

say:10:1210501006:1.text: I'm flattered. I owe everything to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1210501006:1.source_cn: 抬举我了，我都是沾身边这位<style=stress>...
say:10:1210501006:1.male: I'm flattered. I owe everything to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1210501006:1.female: I'm flattered. I owe everything to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:11:1210501007:1.text: You all can stay here, and tell Bols if you need anything.
say:11:1210501007:1.source_cn: 你们安心在这住着，有事吩咐波尔斯。

say:16:1210501010:1.text: It's impressive that you all made it back in one piece.
say:16:1210501010:1.source_cn: ……你们竟然还能完好无损地回来。够厉害。

say:17:1210501011:1.text: Since the leader of the Whispers approved of you, I have nothing to say.
say:17:1210501011:1.source_cn: 连血薇帮当家都认可你们，老子没话说。

say:18:1210501012:1.text: Get some rest upstairs. The best room is yours.
say:18:1210501012:1.source_cn: 上楼吧，最好的那间房是你们的了。

say:0:1210502001:0.text: You guys go up and rest. I'm gonna get myself a drink.
say:0:1210502001:0.source_cn: 你们先上去休息，我找点喝的。
say:0:1210502001:0.male: You guys go up and rest. I'm gonna get myself a drink.
say:0:1210502001:0.female: You guys go up and rest. I'm gonna get myself a drink.

say:2:1210503001:1.text: Finally! Now no one will accuse us of being Water Wights.
say:2:1210503001:1.source_cn: 终于不会再有莫名奇妙的人对我们喊水鬼啦！

say:3:1210503002:1.text: Yes, now we can actually get some rest... Magister, Chippy is a little tired.
say:3:1210503002:1.source_cn: 可以好好休息一会了……唔，主人，满满困了。
say:3:1210503002:1.male: Yes, now we can actually get some rest... Magister, Chippy is a little tired.
say:3:1210503002:1.female: Yes, now we can actually get some rest... Magister, Chippy is a little tired.

choice_prompt:4:1210503002.text: Yes, now we can actually get some rest... Magister, Chippy is a little tired.
choice_prompt:4:1210503002.source_cn: 可以好好休息一会了……唔，主人，满满困了。
choice_prompt:4:1210503002.male: Yes, now we can actually get some rest... Magister, Chippy is a little tired.
choice_prompt:4:1210503002.female: Yes, now we can actually get some rest... Magister, Chippy is a little tired.

narration:5:1210503003:0.text: You all take a short break.

say:7:1210503004:1.text: Chippy feels much better after eating and sleeping!
say:7:1210503004:1.source_cn: 呜哇……吃饱睡足，感觉好多了！

say:10:1210503006:1.text: Downstairs. The innkeeper is talking to him. It seems like a secret conversation.
say:10:1210503006:1.source_cn: 在楼下，旅店老板好像拉着他在说什么，神神秘秘的。

choice_prompt:11:1210503006.text: Downstairs. The innkeeper is talking to him. It seems like a secret conversation.
choice_prompt:11:1210503006.source_cn: 在楼下，旅店老板好像拉着他在说什么，神神秘秘的。

say:12:1210503007:1.text: Yeah, let's sneak over and try to eavesdrop.
say:12:1210503007:1.source_cn: 我也这么想，咱们悄悄溜过去，偷听看看吧。

say:2:1210504001:1.text: You've come up in the world.

say:4:1210504003:1.text: Do those "honored guests" upstairs know what you've done?
say:4:1210504003:1.source_cn: 楼上那几位“贵客”知道你干的好事吗？

say:7:1210504006:1.text: If they knew that you were the one who reported them to the Whispers and that you set this whole thing up with me...
say:7:1210504006:1.male: If they knew that you were the one who reported them to the Whispers and that you set this whole thing up with me...
say:7:1210504006:1.female: If they knew that you were the one who reported them to the Whispers and that you set this whole thing up with me...

say:8:1210504007:1.text: Just tell me how much you want.
say:8:1210504007:1.source_cn: 直接说吧，你还要多少钱？

say:9:1210504008:1.text: Ha! You've always been a clever kid.

say:2:1210505001:1.text: Magister, did you hear what Sinbad said?!
say:2:1210505001:1.source_cn: 主人，您听见了吗？！辛巴达他！
say:2:1210505001:1.male: Magister, did you hear what Sinbad said?!
say:2:1210505001:1.female: Magister, did you hear what Sinbad said?!

say:3:1210505002:1.text: He was in cahoots with the innkeeper! He led us to the inn and had the Whispers ambush us! It was him all this time!
say:3:1210505002:1.source_cn: 原来旅店老板和他是一伙的！之前他引我们到这家旅店，还有...

choice_prompt:4:1210505002.text: He was in cahoots with the innkeeper! He led us to the inn and had the Whispers ambush us! It was him all this time!
choice_prompt:4:1210505002.source_cn: 原来旅店老板和他是一伙的！之前他引我们到这家旅店，还有血薇帮突然在店里埋伏我们——所有这些都是他事先计划好的！

say:5:1210505003:1.text: Even if he saved Chippy's life, this is too much!
say:5:1210505003:1.source_cn: 就算——就算是满满的救命恩人，这样也太过分了！

say:6:1210505004:1.text: Let's go and talk to him!

choice:4:0:1.text: We've got a score to settle.
choice:4:0:1.male: We've got a score to settle.
choice:4:0:1.female: We've got a score to settle.

choice:4:1:2.text: I can't believe he did this.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 引我们入局是为了什么？
choice:4:1:2.male: I can't believe he did this.
choice:4:1:2.female: I can't believe he did this.

say:3:1210506001:1.text: Hey, that was quick. Is something wrong with the room?
say:3:1210506001:1.source_cn: 怎么这么快就下来了？房间有问题？

say:4:1210506002:1.text: Bols lied to us and told the Whispers we were Water Wights. You were behind the whole thing, weren't you?
say:4:1210506002:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，我们被波尔斯坑骗，被举报成水鬼，原来都是你在背...

say:7:1210506004:1.text: Why did you lie to us? You saved Chippy. Chippy wanted you to be our friend.
say:7:1210506004:1.source_cn: 为什么要骗我们，你救了满满，我……我想把你当朋友的！

say:8:1210506005:1.text: This was all a misunderstanding. There was a Water Wight sail on your boat. I saw it when I found you.
say:8:1210506005:1.source_cn: 唉……这是个误会，你们来锈锚港的船上不是有个水鬼的旗帜...

say:9:1210506006:1.text: You mean the symbol that looked like a claw or a bone?
say:9:1210506006:1.source_cn: 就是那个有点像……爪子又有点像……骨头的旗子？！

say:10:1210506007:1.text: Look, anyone who's on a Water Wight vessel is bound to be a Water Wight. Providing the Whispers with information will not only protect Rustport, but you will definitely get rewarded somehow.
say:10:1210506007:1.source_cn: 坐着水鬼帮的船，就是水鬼帮的人——在血薇帮的判断里，就...

say:11:1210506008:1.source_cn: 这是个大误会，那艘船我们是捡到的！

choice_prompt:12:1210506008.source_cn: 这是个大误会，那艘船我们是捡到的！

say:13:1210506009:1.text: Not anymore. I've been with you all this time. I can guarantee you're not connected to those spineless sea slugs.
say:13:1210506009:1.source_cn: 那倒没有。后面这一路跟过来，我确定，你们和那群吃个饭流...

say:14:1210506012:1.text: Okay, now explain how you and Bols set us up.
say:14:1210506012:1.source_cn: 那，解释一下你和波尔斯联手做局坑我们的事！

say:15:1210506013:1.text: Also, you said you were going to help us escape, but instead, you took us to meet Hugin.
say:15:1210506013:1.source_cn: 还有，还有，你说要带我们逃跑，却带我们去见呼金的事！

say:16:1210506014:1.text: Don't worry. I'll explain everything. Bols just wanted you to go fishing at Blackwood Loch.
say:16:1210506014:1.source_cn: 别急，我一个个解释。波尔斯那个局主要是想让你们去黑木湖钓鱼。

say:17:1210506015:1.text: The Water Wights are out at sea all year round, and they use the damedanglers' lights to shine through the fog. So, the Whispers have people guarding Blackwood Loch all the time.
say:17:1210506015:1.source_cn: 水鬼常年在水上活动，都会挂一盏灯照亮迷雾，那灯就是用冥...

say:18:1210506016:1.text: I wanted to use Bols' plan to test who you really were... It's obvious now that you're not one of them.
say:18:1210506016:1.source_cn: 我想用那个方法，试试你们到底是什么身份……很明显，你们...

say:19:1210506017:1.text: But you unexpectedly injured some Whispers, which alerted Lucca, and he went to personally take you down.
say:19:1210506017:1.source_cn: 但没想到，你们竟然打伤了血薇帮的人，所以才惊动了卢卡，...

choice_prompt:20:1210506017.text: But you unexpectedly injured some Whispers, which alerted Lucca, and he went to personally take you down.
choice_prompt:20:1210506017.source_cn: 但没想到，你们竟然打伤了血薇帮的人，所以才惊动了卢卡，他亲自来抓你们。

say:21:1210506018:1.text: Tell us the truth! We were thrown into Darkstone Cave. Was that also your plan?
say:21:1210506018:1.source_cn: 老实交代！我们后来被血薇帮丢去黑石洞，是不是也是你设计好的？

say:22:1210506019:1.text: Ah, Sir Chippy, please don't point your sword at my calf!
say:22:1210506019:1.source_cn: ——哎，满满小骑士，别用剑指着我的——呃，小腿！

say:23:1210506020:1.text: Alright, I knew Sonja would send captives to Darkstone Cave. Helping you was just a cover. My real purpose was to take you to see Hugin. He needed a mage.
say:23:1210506020:1.source_cn: 好吧……我确实知道索尼娅会把水鬼俘虏丢进黑石洞，赚你们...
say:23:1210506020:1.male: Alright, I knew Sonja would send captives to Darkstone Cave. Helping you was just a cover. My real purpose was to take you to see Hugin. He needed a mage.
say:23:1210506020:1.female: Alright, I knew Sonja would send captives to Darkstone Cave. Helping you was just a cover. My real purpose was to take you to see Hugin. He needed a mage.

say:24:1210506021:1.text: You could've introduced us to the Whispers from the very beginning. Why did you tell them we were Water Wights?
say:24:1210506021:1.source_cn: 你明明可以把我们引荐给血薇帮的呀，为什么偏要举报我们是...

say:25:1210506022:1.text: Because Sonja is very set in her ways. If she suspected you, you would never get close to that cannon. Her suspicion would've stopped us from freeing Rustport, and Rustport needed a mage.
say:25:1210506022:1.source_cn: 因为索尼娅很有原则，她不会让疑似水鬼的人靠近大炮。她的...
say:25:1210506022:1.male: Because Sonja is very set in her ways. If she suspected you, you would never get close to that cannon. Her suspicion would've stopped us from freeing Rustport, and Rustport needed a mage.
say:25:1210506022:1.female: Because Sonja is very set in her ways. If she suspected you, you would never get close to that cannon. Her suspicion would've stopped us from freeing Rustport, and Rustport needed a mage.

say:26:1210506023:1.text: Also, Sonja had no idea who I was at the time. Even if I tried recommending you to her, she may not have believed me. She might've even thought that I was working with the Wights.
say:26:1210506023:1.source_cn: 而且我也和索尼娅没交情，就算我向索尼娅推荐你们，她也未...

say:27:1210506024:1.text: Look... I wanted to tell you, but I didn't know how I was going to apologize. Instead, you found out first. I'm really sorry.
say:27:1210506024:1.source_cn: 唉……对不起。我也没想着能瞒多久，还在思考怎么向你们道...

choice_prompt:28:1210506024.text: Look... I wanted to tell you, but I didn't know how I was going to apologize. Instead, you found out first. I'm really sorry.
choice_prompt:28:1210506024.source_cn: 唉……对不起。我也没想着能瞒多久，还在思考怎么向你们道歉呢，就先被你们发现了。我很抱歉——

say:29:1210506025:1.text: If it helps, you can get a few shots in. I won't fight back.
say:29:1210506025:1.source_cn: 要是能让你们消气的话，动手吧。我做好心理准备了。是我不对。

choice:28:1:2.text: It makes sense, but I'm still unhappy.
choice:28:1:2.male: It makes sense, but I'm still unhappy.
choice:28:1:2.female: It makes sense, but I'm still unhappy.

say:32:1210506010:1.text: Yeah, times are tough in Rustport right now, and... I needed the money.
say:32:1210506010:1.source_cn: 事出有因，锈锚港正在非常时期。而且……我很需要钱。

say:33:1210506011:1.text: I apologize, I never should've betrayed the trust of a dear friend. It was a grievous mistake, one that haunts me with every breath!
say:33:1210506011:1.source_cn: 请原谅，我只能说很抱歉。

choice:6:1:2.text: I already guessed it was you.
choice:6:1:2.male: I already guessed it was you.
choice:6:1:2.female: I already guessed it was you.

choice:6:2:3.text: I can't believe I trusted you!
choice:6:2:3.male: I can't believe I trusted you!
choice:6:2:3.female: I can't believe I trusted you!

say:3:1210508001:1.text: I understand that you're angry, but why did you tie me up?
say:3:1210508001:1.source_cn: 喂，生气就生气，怎么还把我捆上了。

say:4:1210508002:1.text: To prevent you from doing bad things again.

say:5:1210508003:1.source_cn: 因为你已经失去了我们宝贵的信任！

choice_prompt:6:1210508003.source_cn: 因为你已经失去了我们宝贵的信任！

say:7:1210508004:1.text: I guess I brought it upon myself.
say:7:1210508004:1.source_cn: 啊，这……好吧，我自作自受，活该。

say:8:1210508005:1.text: But don't sleep too soundly tonight. After all the commotion you've caused, who knows what big moves the Whispers might make?
say:8:1210508005:1.source_cn: 不过好心提醒一句，今晚别睡太死。被你们这么一闹，指不定...

say:9:1210508006:1.text: Don't listen to Sinbad. He's trying to trick us again.
say:9:1210508006:1.source_cn: 不听不听，辛巴达的嘴总是骗人。

choice:6:0:1.text: You can sleep like this tonight.
choice:6:0:1.male: You can sleep like this tonight.
choice:6:0:1.female: You can sleep like this tonight.

choice:6:2:3.text: Sorry, but we need to rest now.
choice:6:2:3.source_cn: 对不住啦，我们该休息了
choice:6:2:3.male: Sorry, but we need to rest now.
choice:6:2:3.female: Sorry, but we need to rest now.

say:0:1210509001:0.text: Hey, hurry up! They're all asleep...
say:0:1210509001:0.source_cn: 嘿哥们，趁他们都睡了，手脚快点！

say:1:1210509002:0.source_cn: 主人，好像有奇怪的声音……

say:2:1210509003:0.text: Is Sinbad trying to get away? Let's go see.
say:2:1210509003:0.source_cn: 不会是辛巴达跑了吧？我们看看！

say:1:1210512001:0.text: With the Whispers guarding the place, how could these guys get in?
say:1:1210512001:0.source_cn: 有血薇帮把守，这群家伙怎么可能混进来？

say:3:1210512002:0.text: You didn't listen to my advice, did you?
say:3:1210512002:0.source_cn: 早就提醒你们了，别睡太沉。

say:5:1210512003:1.text: Chippy knows! There must be a secret passageway!
say:5:1210512003:1.source_cn: 满满知道，绝对是有暗道！

say:7:1210512005:1.text: Hey, don't leave me alone! I know this place. I can help.
say:7:1210512005:1.source_cn: 哎，哎，别丢下我！我对这地儿熟，能帮上忙！

choice_prompt:8:1210512005.text: Hey, don't leave me alone! I know this place. I can help.
choice_prompt:8:1210512005.source_cn: 哎，哎，别丢下我！我对这地儿熟，能帮上忙！

say:9:1210512006:1.text: I know I owe you, so I'll make it up to you.
say:9:1210512006:1.source_cn: 行、行。我欠你们的，我认了。

say:10:1210512007:1.text: Alright, but I'm keeping my eye on you.

choice:8:0:1.text: Well, I'm not going to untie you.
choice:8:0:1.male: Well, I'm not going to untie you.
choice:8:0:1.female: Well, I'm not going to untie you.

choice:8:1:2.text: Okay, I'll give you one last chance.
choice:8:1:2.male: Okay, I'll give you one last chance.
choice:8:1:2.female: Okay, I'll give you one last chance.

say:0:1210513001:0.text: Look! On the right side. That wall. I feel the wind from somewhere.
say:0:1210513001:0.source_cn: 看那边，水桶旁的绳子，被风吹起来了。

say:0:1210514001:0.text: There seems to be a passage behind this door. Let's go in and take a look.
say:0:1210514001:0.source_cn: 果然有暗道！主人，我们进去看看吧！
say:0:1210514001:0.male: There seems to be a passage behind this door. Let's go in and take a look.
say:0:1210514001:0.female: There seems to be a passage behind this door. Let's go in and take a look.

say:1:1210514002:0.text: Ahh. Looks like I won't be sleeping tonight. How will this handsome face fare without a full night's rest?

say:0:1210516001:0.text: Are those people from the Carmine Whispers?

say:1:1210516002:0.text: Magister, go tell them we're honored guests of the Whispers.
say:1:1210516002:0.source_cn: 主人问问他，毕竟我们现在可是血薇帮的贵客！
say:1:1210516002:0.male: Magister, go tell them we're honored guests of the Whispers.
say:1:1210516002:0.female: Magister, go tell them we're honored guests of the Whispers.

say:0:1210518001:0.text: Didn't Sonja say we were guests? Why did the Whispers attack us?
say:0:1210518001:0.source_cn: 索尼娅不是说我们是贵客吗？！为什么血薇帮还攻击我们？

say:1:1210518002:0.text: Also, if the Whispers were guarding this place, how could Water Wights use the secret passage?
say:1:1210518002:0.source_cn: 而且有血薇帮在把守，水鬼怎么可能通过密道？

say:0:1210520001:0.text: Are Whispers and Water Wights patrolling together?!
say:0:1210520001:0.source_cn: 那是……血薇帮的竟然和水鬼一起巡逻？

say:1:1210521002:0.text: We can't let them get out alive!

say:2:1210524001:1.text: Magister, just now Chippy saw the Whispers working with the Water Wights. Is Chippy dreaming?
say:2:1210524001:1.source_cn: 主人，刚才血薇帮竟然和水鬼的人站在一边？满满难道在做梦吗？
say:2:1210524001:1.male: Magister, just now Chippy saw the Whispers working with the Water Wights. Is Chippy dreaming?
say:2:1210524001:1.female: Magister, just now Chippy saw the Whispers working with the Water Wights. Is Chippy dreaming?

say:3:1210524002:1.text: Yeah, something's wrong. They looked like they were cooperating with each other.
say:3:1210524002:1.source_cn: 不对劲……他们看起来不像敌对，而是在合作！

say:4:1210524003:1.text: Where does this lift lead to anyway? Both the Carmine Whispers and the Water Wights were guarding it.
say:4:1210524003:1.source_cn: 这个电梯到底通向哪里，竟然能让血薇帮和水鬼帮合作守卫？

say:5:1210524004:1.text: Sonja told everyone we were guests, so why did the Whispers here attack us?
say:5:1210524004:1.source_cn: 而且索尼娅明明把我们当贵客了，为什么这里的血薇帮守卫还...

choice_prompt:6:1210524004.text: Sonja told everyone we were guests, so why did the Whispers here attack us?
choice_prompt:6:1210524004.source_cn: 而且索尼娅明明把我们当贵客了，为什么这里的血薇帮守卫还会攻击我们？

choice:6:0:1.text: Something is happening in the Whispers.
choice:6:0:1.male: Something is happening in the Whispers.
choice:6:0:1.female: Something is happening in the Whispers.

choice:6:2:3.text: Let's go up and take a look.
choice:6:2:3.male: Let's go up and take a look.
choice:6:2:3.female: Let's go up and take a look.

say:0:1210525001:0.text: I believe we're in the Whispers' territory.
say:0:1210525001:0.source_cn: 这墙上是血薇，我们来了血薇帮的地盘？

say:1:1210525002:0.text: How did the secret passage from the inn lead here?
say:1:1210525002:0.source_cn: 旅店的密道怎么会通向这里？

say:5:1210529003:1.text: Are you going to kill me, Sonja?

say:7:1210529005:1.text: I am your father. If I hadn't saved you from that shipwreck, you would've died back then like your sister.
say:7:1210529005:1.source_cn: 我是你的“父亲”……当年，如果不是我把你救起，你早就死...

say:9:1210529007:1.text: I raised you like one of my own, taught you how to use a sword, and sent you to the best schools. I even handed you the Carmine Whispers. If you kill me now, you'll lose the support of everyone.
say:9:1210529007:1.source_cn: 我把你当亲生孩子一样养大，教你剑术，让你上学……甚至还...

say:10:1210529008:1.text: Do you remember when I pinned that rose on your chest and told everyone that you were my child? You promised me eternal loyalty.
say:10:1210529008:1.source_cn: 还记得吗？我把血薇别在你胸口，告诉所有人，你就是我的“...

say:12:1210529010:1.text: You can't bring yourself to take my life, my child. Killing me would not benefit you. Accept your fate.
say:12:1210529010:1.source_cn: 我的……我的孩子。你不可能杀我，你也杀不了我。认命吧。

say:16:1210529012:1.text: No way, Sonja. Don't tell me you're buying this!
say:16:1210529012:1.source_cn: 不是吧，索尼娅，你吃这套？

say:17:1210529013:1.text: Do you really believe that Tesio regards you as family? If you believe that, then Lucca is my twin brother.
say:17:1210529013:1.source_cn: 你相信泰西欧当你是亲人？还是信我和卢卡是失散多年的亲兄弟？

say:26:1210529017:0.text: Sonja?! I can't believe you're doing this!
say:26:1210529017:0.source_cn: ——你？！索尼娅？！你竟然让手下碰我？！

say:29:1210529018:1.text: Whew, I thought I was the one you were gonna put in chains!
say:29:1210529018:1.source_cn: 原来是给这老东西上铐？哈哈哈哈！

say:32:1210529019:1.text: Father, you've grown old. Your eyesight isn't what it used to be, and you nag all the time.
say:32:1210529019:1.source_cn: 父亲大人，你真的老了，变唠叨了，而且眼神也不好。

say:33:1210529020:1.text: Look at me. I'm no one's child.
say:33:1210529020:1.source_cn: 看清楚！我，索尼娅，不是谁的孩子。

say:34:1210529021:1.text: I'm the boss of the Carmine Whispers... after you die.
say:34:1210529021:1.source_cn: 我是血薇帮的老大——在你死后。

say:36:1210529023:1.text: Years ago, pirates were rampant in Rustport. Many people wanted to leave.
say:36:1210529023:1.source_cn: 当年，锈锚港海盗横行，很多人想离开锈锚港。

say:37:1210529024:1.text: So you organized a shipwreck. You had explosives in the cabin and had the main mast compromised. You purposefully put people in danger so that the Carmine Whispers would come to their rescue.
say:37:1210529024:1.source_cn: 于是你策划了一场海难，你让人磨断了桅杆，船舱里绑了炸药...

say:38:1210529025:1.text: As expected... after the shipwreck, the popularity of the Whispers soared, and everyone respected you and called you the Don.
say:38:1210529025:1.source_cn: 果然……海难后，血薇帮的人望迅速攀升，大家都尊称你为教父。

say:39:1210529026:1.text: You're probably wondering how I know all of this.

say:40:1210529027:1.text: Don't forget. You taught me everything you knew.
say:40:1210529027:1.source_cn: 别忘了，你把我教的很好。

say:41:1210529028:1.text: What's the big deal? I gave everyone a new purpose... A new life! I am their savior.
say:41:1210529028:1.source_cn: 这有什么，我给了他们新的生命……我就是他们的救世主。

say:42:1210529029:1.text: Everyone knows that help isn't free.
say:42:1210529029:1.source_cn: 所有人都应该知道，救世主的帮助不是无偿的。

say:43:1210529030:1.text: Even saviors have to pay for their sins.
say:43:1210529030:1.source_cn: 救世主犯下罪孽也是要偿还的。

say:44:1210529031:1.text: I grew the Carmine Whispers with my blood, sweat, and tears. What's wrong with that? If you want flowers to bloom, blood is the perfect fertilizer.
say:44:1210529031:1.source_cn: 我用鲜血哺育血薇帮，有什么错呢？花要想开的好，沾血的肥...

say:45:1210529032:1.source_cn: 别狡辩了，你会迎来审判。

say:1:1210530002:0.text: After him! He's using the secret passage!

say:2:1210531001:1.text: I didn't know the secret passageway was this big.
say:2:1210531001:1.source_cn: 这里……居然有这么大的密道！

choice_prompt:3:1210531001.text: I didn't know the secret passageway was this big.
choice_prompt:3:1210531001.source_cn: 这里……居然有这么大的密道！

say:4:1210531002:0.text: It's funny. If the Water Wights had never attacked, you would've never found this secret passageway.
say:4:1210531002:0.source_cn: 真稀奇，是不是如果没有今天的事，水鬼把刀架在你们脖子上...

say:5:1210531003:1.text: I thought the Whispers were all-seeing, but it turns out you wouldn't notice a rat even if it was gnawing under your floorboards.
say:5:1210531003:1.source_cn: 还以为血薇帮手眼通天，结果连眼皮下的耗子都发现不了。你...

say:11:1210531005:1.text: We knew the Water Wights were digging tunnels to Rustport. We sealed many of them. However, we missed the biggest one, it seems.
say:11:1210531005:1.source_cn: 我所得知的消息是，水鬼在挖通往锈锚港城里的地道，我们封...

say:12:1210531006:0.text: You're the one who never checked on the place!
say:12:1210531006:0.source_cn: 谁让你们从不定期派人检查维护这里？

say:13:1210531007:1.text: ... Yes, it's negligence on my part. If you have anything else to say, please wait until we catch up with Tesio.
say:13:1210531007:1.source_cn: ……是我的疏忽，还有什么意见，等追到泰西欧后再说。

say:16:1210531008:1.text: If we don't catch up to him soon, Tesio is going to get away!
say:16:1210531008:1.source_cn: 对啊，我们再不追上，泰西欧就跑远啦！

say:19:1210531009:1.text: It smells like rust in here. We need to get out of here as soon as possible!
say:19:1210531009:1.source_cn: 天呐，这里的空气都是铁锈味，我们快点出去吧！

say:0:1210536001:0.text: Sonja, don't make things difficult for us.

say:0:1210537001:0.text: Tesio and Sinbad ran out of sight already!

say:1:1210537002:0.text: Hurry up! Don't get left behind.

say:0:1210538001:0.source_cn: 这里的泥土湿软，看！是脚印！

say:0:1210541001:0.text: Found the exit. Someone's guarding it.

say:0:1210543001:0.source_cn: 泰西欧应该已经从这出去了。

say:0:1210546001:0.text: Look! There's a net by the hill. We can use that to climb up!
say:0:1210546001:0.source_cn: 瞧，后边山坡有个吊网，我们可以爬上去！

cinematic_dialogue:2:1210526001:.text: Huh? Where did you come from?

say:6:1210527001:1.text: This place is surrounded by my people. How did you get here?
say:6:1210527001:1.source_cn: ……这里已经被我的人包围了，你们从哪里进来的？

say:10:1210527005:1.text: The Water Wights launched a sneak attack in the middle of the night, but the magister drove them away.
say:10:1210527005:1.source_cn: 水鬼帮半夜偷袭，被主人打跑了。
say:10:1210527005:1.male: The Water Wights launched a sneak attack in the middle of the night, but the magister drove them away.
say:10:1210527005:1.female: The Water Wights launched a sneak attack in the middle of the night, but the magister drove them away.

say:11:1210527006:1.text: We found a secret passage, and it brought us here.
say:11:1210527006:1.source_cn: 我们发现了一条密道，穿过密道就到了这里！

say:12:1210527007:1.text: Water Wights... What else did you see in the secret passage?
say:12:1210527007:1.source_cn: 水鬼……你们在密道里还看见了什么？

say:13:1210527008:1.text: We saw several guards! Some were Water Wights. Some were from the Carmine Whispers.
say:13:1210527008:1.source_cn: 看到了守卫！有血薇帮的，还有水鬼！

say:15:1210527010:1.text: No... they were guarding the lift together.
say:15:1210527010:1.source_cn: 不……他们在一起守卫着密道的机关电梯。

say:17:1210527011:1.text: Lucca, go down and take a look.

narration:18:1210527012:1.text: Lucca enters the secret passage and returns in less than half an hour.

say:22:1210527014:1.text: Father, do you have anything else to say?
say:22:1210527014:1.source_cn: 父亲大人，您还要狡辩吗？

say:26:1210527016:1.text: Colluding with Water Wights and stealing our secrets... The Carmine Whispers do not tolerate betrayal. You taught me that.
say:26:1210527016:1.source_cn: 勾结水鬼，窃取血薇帮机密……血薇容不下背叛，您教我的。

say:27:1210527017:1.source_cn: 呵呵，我的确把你教的很好……

say:28:1210527018:1.text: However, you will not end my life here.
say:28:1210527018:1.source_cn: 但是，咳咳……我的人生，还轮不到你来和我说结束。

say:29:1210527019:1.text: Come at me if you dare.

narration:32:120105212:0.text: You accidentally stumble into the Carmine Whispers' territory through the secret passage and see Sonja confronting Tesio.
narration:32:120105212:0.source_cn: 你们通过密道意外闯进了血薇帮的地盘，看到索尼娅正在和泰...

say:3:1210533001:1.text: Slow down. You can't get past that door.
say:3:1210533001:1.source_cn: 跑慢点，前面的门你们过不去。

say:5:1210533003:1.text: Look, this door can only be opened with a special mechanism.
say:5:1210533003:1.source_cn: 瞧，这道门是单向门，只能从一边打开。

say:6:1210533004:1.text: Do you know how to open it?

say:9:1210533007:0.text: Yeah, well, you have to untie my rope first.
say:9:1210533007:0.source_cn: 你们得先把我的绳子解开。

say:10:1210533008:1.text: Wait, you're not lying to us again, are you? Trying to find a way to escape...
say:10:1210533008:1.source_cn: 等等，你不会又在骗我们，想趁机逃走吧……

say:11:1210533009:1.text: Come on, guys! There are so many of you, and the great Magister Merlin is here as well. What are you afraid of?
say:11:1210533009:1.source_cn: 你们这么多人，还有大魔法师梅林在，难道还怕我一个？
say:11:1210533009:1.male: Come on, guys! There are so many of you, and the great Magister Merlin is here as well. What are you afraid of?
say:11:1210533009:1.female: Come on, guys! There are so many of you, and the great Magister Merlin is here as well. What are you afraid of?

say:12:1210533010:1.text: The only way you'd know how to find this door mechanism is if you were a part of the Water Wights and a traitor to the Carmine Whispers.
say:12:1210533010:1.source_cn: 会开这道门的，除了血薇帮的叛徒，就是水鬼。

say:13:1210533011:1.text: So which side are you on?

say:14:1210533012:1.text: Hey, don't swing that sword around! We're friends, remember? Let me explain.
say:14:1210533012:1.source_cn: 哎，哎！朋友，有话好好说，别拿剑吓唬人。

say:15:1210533013:0.text: A guy like me who barely makes a living can't depend on just one employer. I have to freelance. I have to hustle. Can I really turn down a job from the Water Wights?
say:15:1210533013:0.source_cn: 我这种在码头勉强讨生活的穷人，不可能只有一个雇主。再说...

say:16:1210533014:1.text: If you open the door and help us catch Tesio, I won't feed you to the sharks. How's that?
say:16:1210533014:1.source_cn: 开门，帮我们抓到泰西欧，我可以不把你扔到海里喂鱼。

say:17:1210533015:1.text: Untie me and it's a deal.
say:17:1210533015:1.source_cn: 我只想拜托你解开绳子，放我自由。

say:18:1210533016:1.text: What do you think, Magister Merlin?
say:18:1210533016:1.male: What do you think, Magister Merlin?
say:18:1210533016:1.female: What do you think, Magister Merlin?

choice_prompt:19:1210533016.text: What do you think, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:19:1210533016.male: What do you think, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:19:1210533016.female: What do you think, Magister Merlin?

say:20:1210533019:0.text: Thanks. Let me just open this door for ya.
say:20:1210533019:0.source_cn: 呼……感谢。我这就帮你们开门……

say:27:1210534001:0.text: Sinbad ran away! Chippy knew we couldn't trust him!
say:27:1210534001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达果然跑了，就知道不能相信他！

say:28:1210534002:0.text: He's not running away. He's chasing after Tesio.
say:28:1210534002:0.source_cn: 不用追，他不是逃跑，而是去追泰西欧了。

say:29:1210534003:0.text: Why is he chasing Tesio? Does he have a grudge against him or something?
say:29:1210534003:0.source_cn: 为什么他要追泰西欧？他们有仇还是……

say:30:1210534004:1.text: Long story short: yes, he does.

say:33:1210534007:1.text: It's rather complicated. You can ask him later. Let's not lose sight of him.
say:33:1210534007:1.source_cn: 这事比较复杂，你们以后问他吧，我们先追，别跟丢了。

narration:35:12010532:0.text: Sinbad dashes out immediately after opening the door to the secret passage.
narration:35:12010532:0.source_cn: 辛巴达帮你们打开密道的机关门，抢先一步追了出去。

say:36:1210533017:0.text: Stop joking around. We still have to catch Tesio. You know I can help!
say:36:1210533017:0.source_cn: 喂喂，拜托，不是还要追泰西欧吗，我真能帮上忙！

say:37:1210533018:0.text: There won't be a second chance after this.
say:37:1210533018:0.source_cn: 我不会再给你第二次机会。

choice:19:1:2.text: We can tie him up again after.
choice:19:1:2.male: We can tie him up again after.
choice:19:1:2.female: We can tie him up again after.

say:7:1210545001:0.text: Magister, they're running towards the bridge!
say:7:1210545001:0.source_cn: 主人，他们往桥那边跑了！
say:7:1210545001:0.male: Magister, they're running towards the bridge!
say:7:1210545001:0.female: Magister, they're running towards the bridge!

say:11:1210545003:1.text: That's right. The village with those women.

choice_prompt:12:1210545003.text: That's right. The village with those women.

say:13:1210545004:1.text: Sinbad's home is a village run by a group of widows. After Sinbad's father died, those women raised him.
say:13:1210545004:1.source_cn: 辛巴达的家，一群海员遗孀撑起的地方，辛巴达的父亲死后，...

say:16:1210545005:1.text: Chippy didn't know that about him...
say:16:1210545005:1.source_cn: 看不出来，那个吊儿郎当的家伙居然……

say:17:1210545006:1.text: You three go on ahead. Lucca and I will bring more men to support you as soon as we can.
say:17:1210545006:1.source_cn: 行了，你们先去追，我和卢卡随后带人支援你们。

say:18:1210545007:1.text: Wait, why should we help you chase down your enemy?
say:18:1210545007:1.source_cn: 等等，我们为什么要帮你们追叛徒？

say:20:1210545008:1.text: Yes, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is not one of your followers. Neither are Chippy and I.
say:20:1210545008:1.male: Yes, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is not one of your followers. Neither are Chippy and I.
say:20:1210545008:1.female: Yes, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is not one of your followers. Neither are Chippy and I.

say:21:1210545009:1.text: Rustport is being targeted by the Water Wights and the Dead Tide Fleet. They bribed Tesio, and now he's working for them. The Carmine Whispers need your help.
say:21:1210545009:1.source_cn: 锈锚港现在被水鬼和死潮舰队针对，泰西欧又被他们收买了，...

say:22:1210545010:1.text: If you don't want to, I can also arrange a boat to take you away.
say:22:1210545010:1.source_cn: 如果你们不愿意，我也可以安排船送你们离开——

say:23:1210545011:1.text: No, the kraken is still out there!
say:23:1210545011:1.source_cn: 不行，那个长着触手的大家伙还在海上！

say:24:1210545012:1.text: Then let's destroy the Dead Tide Fleet together, or else you'll never be able to leave.
say:24:1210545012:1.source_cn: 那就和我一起除掉死潮舰队吧。死潮不除，你们没法顺利离开。

choice_prompt:25:1210545012.text: Then let's destroy the Dead Tide Fleet together, or else you'll never be able to leave.
choice_prompt:25:1210545012.source_cn: 那就和我一起除掉死潮舰队吧。死潮不除，你们没法顺利离开。

say:26:1210545013:1.text: Tesio, the Water Wights, the Dead Tide Fleet... Defeat and capture them in one fell swoop.
say:26:1210545013:1.source_cn: 泰西欧，水鬼帮，死潮舰队，逐个击破，一网打尽。

choice_prompt:27:1210545013.text: Tesio, the Water Wights, the Dead Tide Fleet... Defeat and capture them in one fell swoop.
choice_prompt:27:1210545013.source_cn: 泰西欧，水鬼帮，死潮舰队，逐个击破，一网打尽。

say:28:1210545014:1.text: I hope we work well together. I'll see you later.

say:29:1210545015:1.text: Of course, they want to work with us. Only Magister Merlin can deal with these types of situations.
say:29:1210545015:1.source_cn: 又是合作……果然，他们没了梅林就解决不了问题。
say:29:1210545015:1.male: Of course, they want to work with us. Only Magister Merlin can deal with these types of situations.
say:29:1210545015:1.female: Of course, they want to work with us. Only Magister Merlin can deal with these types of situations.

say:30:1210545016:1.text: That's the problem with being so powerful. Everyone wants your help. Alright, let's catch up to them.
say:30:1210545016:1.source_cn: 或许这就是强大的烦恼吧，我们赶紧追上，别跟丢了。

choice:27:0:1.text: I'd be happy to see them go down.
choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 我也看水鬼和死潮不爽
choice:27:0:1.male: I'd be happy to see them go down.
choice:27:0:1.female: I'd be happy to see them go down.

choice:25:1:2.text: What do you need me to do?
choice:25:1:2.male: What do you need me to do?
choice:25:1:2.female: What do you need me to do?

narration:32:12010537:0.text: When you leave the secret passage, you see Tesio running to the other end of the bridge with Sinbad hot on his trail.
narration:32:12010537:0.source_cn: 离开密道后，你们看到泰西欧被辛巴达紧追着逃向了桥的对岸。

subtitle:1:1211084001:.text: Things are about to get interesting...

subtitle:3:1211084003:.text: You aren't here this late just for tea, are you?

subtitle:3:1211084011:.text: it's time for you to retire...
